A [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''droid supervisor''' gave orders to [[Droid/Legends|droids]] working at the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], including [[R2-D7]] and [[Inventory Droid Assistant|I.D.A.]],<ref name="ST Tokyo" /> a droid that was difficult to motivate.<ref name="CGTST">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref>.

==Behind the scenes==
The Mon Calamari was a puppet created by and performed by [[Lynette Eklund]].<ref name="EE Eklund">{{EndorExpress|url=star-wars-adventures/star-tours/creating-star-tours/2010/03/interview-with-lynette-eklund-ackbar-puppeteer|text=Interview with the Mon Calamari puppet builder}}</ref> He appeared on a video screen in an area of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] queue, exclusive to the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the ride.<ref name="ST Tokyo" />
